description: Free: which public x402 facilitators (PayAI, x402.org, GoPlausible, x402.rs, Dexter, Daydreams, Semantic Pay and more) answer right now, and which networks and schemes each one settles. Give a network (CAIP-2 like eip155:8453, or an x402 v1 name like base, solana, xlayer) to get only the facilitators that settle it now. Read from each facilitator's GET /supported at most every 5 minutes; never verifies or settles anything. Use it to pick a facilitator for a new paid endpoint, or to see why payments on a network fail.

network.description: A network to filter on, e.g. eip155:196 or xlayer

facilitators.description: Per facilitator: id, name, url, state (up, slow, down, not_checked), note, networks (CAIP-2, testnet flag, schemes), schemes, x402_versions, recent checks, last_up
